tools.name: get_athlete_profile

tools.name: get_training_state
tools.description: Get the current state snapshot, metrics, and snapshot hash.

tools.name: list_training_sessions
tools.description: List normalized training sessions.

tools.name: list_wellness
tools.description: List normalized daily wellness and per-field provenance.

tools.name: get_wellness_day

tools.name: get_training_taxonomy

tools.name: calculate_heart_rate_zones

tools.name: evaluate_rpe_autoregulation
tools.description: Evaluate a load adjustment only when RPE is supplied.

tools.name: evaluate_progression
tools.description: Evaluate the MVP progression policy.

tools.name: get_next_training_day
tools.description: Get the first unfinished scheduled training day on or after a local date.

tools.name: list_planned_sessions
tools.description: List planned sessions across the current plan, optionally filtered by an inclusive scheduledDate window.

tools.name: validate_next_training_day_sessions
tools.description: Validate one or more sessions for the current next training day without saving them.

tools.name: create_session_template
tools.description: Create a local reusable single-domain archetype. Submitting a built-in template ID derives a user-owned replacement with that ID and hides the original in the library. Read get_training_taxonomy first. Do not include exercises, sets, reps, distance, duration, load, or recovery demand.

tools.name: update_session_template
tools.description: Update a local archetype. A built-in original cannot be updated directly; derive it first by creating a template with its ID. Template edits never rewrite Weekly Sessions.

tools.name: delete_session_template
tools.description: Delete an unreferenced user template, or hide a built-in template (the code-defined original is retained), only after the user explicitly requests deletion.

tools.name: save_next_training_day_sessions
tools.description: After explicit confirmation, append or replace complete executable Session prescriptions on the next training day. A templateRef is optional provenance and never supplies missing fields.

tools.name: update_planned_session
tools.description: Add a manual completed workout, skip, restore, or move the current planned training occurrence after explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: record_training_session
tools.description: Record an actual completed training session in Training History. Athria's deterministic reconciliation algorithm performs any Current Plan matching; never choose a plannedSessionId.

tools.name: override_training_session_plan_match
tools.description: Apply only a user's explicit correction, replacement, or rejection of a workout's automatic plan match. Never infer or choose plannedSessionId during normal matching. A non-null value applies the exact user-directed same-day override; null marks the workout intentionally unplanned and excludes it from later automatic matching.

tools.name: allow_automatic_plan_match
tools.description: After explicit user confirmation, clear a workout's intentionally-unplanned decision and allow deterministic automatic matching again.

tools.name: update_manual_training_session
tools.description: After explicit user confirmation, update the exact start time or duration of a canonical workout that contains a manual source.

tools.name: remove_manual_training_source
tools.description: After explicit user confirmation, remove the manual source from a canonical workout. Synced source observations are never deleted.

tools.name: update_wellness
tools.description: Directly update one wellness day only after the user explicitly confirms the values.

tools.name: update_athlete_profile
tools.description: Directly apply a Profile patch only after the user explicitly confirms it. explicitRecoveryDays is the minimum day gap between high-recovery-demand sessions. injuries record known injuries or diagnoses (the factual why) and constraintNotes record movement-level restrictions (the what): notes may be derived from injuries but must never restate the diagnosis. Both are advisory context only: at most 10 entries of up to 200 characters each, one issue per entry, no duplicates. mesocycleDurationWeeks is the athlete's preferred mesocycle length in weeks (1-8); use it as the default durationWeeks for a new plan unless the user requests a specific length. raceDays records upcoming or past target races as { date (YYYY-MM-DD), sport } entries; use them to shape mesocycle peaking. Advisory only, up to 50 entries.

tools.name: get_plan_adjustment_review
tools.description: Review the current plan against fresh profile, training, calendar, and wellness facts. Returns deterministic reasons, scope, hard overrides, data gaps, and freshness hashes without modifying the plan.

tools.name: report_skill_version
tools.description: Record which Athria Skill version and content hash the host agent actually loaded. Athria injects this handshake into the Skill archives it exports for Claude Desktop, whose Skills are installed in Claude's own settings; Athria cannot read that list itself. Writes a local report for the Athria desktop app and never changes training data.

tools.name: create_plan_draft
tools.description: Create a persistent mesocycle draft. New drafts contain plan metadata without weeks; current_plan clones the current plan.

tools.name: list_plan_drafts
tools.description: List persistent mesocycle draft summaries for the local athlete.

tools.name: get_plan_draft
tools.description: Get a draft summary, or one week when weekNumber is supplied.

tools.name: upsert_plan_draft_week
tools.description: Atomically replace one complete week in an open plan draft.

tools.name: validate_plan_draft
tools.description: Assemble and validate a persisted draft without changing the current plan.

tools.name: commit_plan_draft
tools.description: After explicit approval, atomically validate and commit an open draft as the current plan.

tools.name: discard_plan_draft
tools.description: Discard an open plan draft without changing the current plan.
